pdfs.title: Kefli in five slides
pdfs.markdown:
## Save anything

Share a link from any app on the phone. Press the shortcut in the browser. The text arrives clean and stays offline.

## Read it clean

One column, your size, your colours. Images where the writer put them. Your place kept on every device.

## Listen to it

The phone's own voice reads the article aloud. Each word lights up as it is spoken.

It keeps going with the screen locked.

## Keep it

Your library lives under your own key. Copies are mirrored away from our servers. It outlives the service that saved it.
